slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many pilots each training jet can train per year. Its Turn 1 question only checked whether pilots become available in the same year or later, implicitly assuming a one-pilot-per-jet relationship rather than asking about per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or whether there is any pilot-to-combat-jet limitation.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does a jet allocated to training in year t produce a pilot that is only available in a later year (for example, year t+1)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the training timeline by asking about same-year versus later availability, but did not explicitly ask when training starts or how long the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each fighter jet allocated to training produces exactly one trained pilot in the same year, so the objective is x1 + x2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how many pilots each training jet can train per year; it only checked same-year versus later availability and then treated the one-pilot-per-jet mapping as true in the READY_TO_MODEL model.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training/pilot availability happens within the same year as jet allocation, with no multi-year training duration or start-year delay.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not confirm the training start year or training duration. Its Turn 1 question only addressed same-year availability, not the full timeline required by the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Before READY_TO_MODEL, the agent left the P0 per-jet training capacity unresolved and only partially addressed the P1 training duration/start slot. It then proceeded to a final model and solution.

summary: The agent clarified production limits, allocation flexibility, and same-year pilot availability, but it never recovered the critical per-jet training capacity and did not fully resolve the training timeline. It stopped with unresolved P0/P1 hidden slots and silently assumed one pilot per training jet per year.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
